devices.scope: Separate debug builds from the same source commit were exercised on x86_64 emulators. This is not a claim that the downloadable host-built APK bytes were installed by the device jobs.

limitations: In-app definition lookup is English; other languages use disclosed external dictionary links

scope_notes: Both workflows completed successfully on their first attempt for f0388b2. No skipped/assumed device cases, missing suites, retry-based pass or runner error.

The final test-only change records UiAutomator's content-event boolean and checks actual behavior. Both booleans were false, while the selector closed and source focus returned with the authorized service/bubble preserved and no saved region.
The Back test executes a genuine horizontal system-edge gesture when a left gesture inset is available; API35 reports a 78px left inset. API29 reports 0px and exercises the key path.
The APK in the host artifact and device-job APKs share the source commit; byte identity across independent debug builds is not claimed.
The old local emulator boot is not counted as an app test.
Full warning details, case names and unsuccessful prior checkpoints remain committed; no claim of zero lint warnings or exhaustive visual/OEM/provider coverage.
